units: <cite ref="Shabbat 29a:8">Sabb. 29ᵃ</cite> <he>ומק׳ מטלניות שנו כאן</he> and they teach here rules about one of the pettiest kinds of strips.
<cite ref="Shabbat 39b:6">Ib. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>חוץ מק׳ מטלניות</he> except the rule concerning the lightest kinds &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Challah 4:5">Ḥall. IV, 5</cite> <he>נמצא חומרו קוּלּוֹ</he> consequently the stricter opinion (of R. Akiba) implies the eventual lenient ruling. Y. ib. 59ᵈ bot. <he>קולו חומרו</he> the lenient rule implies eventually the stricter rule.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 11:2">Snh. XI, 2</cite> <he>נמצא חומרו קולו</he> his severer offence (in giving a practical decision without authorization to teach) is the cause of his acquittal from responsibility.—Pl. <he>קוּלִּים</he>, <cite ref="S00342"><he>קוּלִּין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 11:3:1">Y. Snh. XI, 30ᵃ</cite> bot.

<cite ref="Chullin 43b:15">Ḥull. 43ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>מקוּלֵּי בית שמאי ומק׳ וכ׳</he> he that follows the school of Shammai where its rulings are the easier, and again the school of Hillel where its rulings are the easier.
Keth. 110ᵇ מקולי כתובה וכ׳ they taught here one of the lenient practices concerning the wife’s dowry; a. e.—קוּלּוֹת (fr. קוּלָּה) light, minor sins.
